description:
You are an agricultural engineer designing a formal demonstration garden for a county extension office. Create a plan-view layout drawing in LibreCAD with the following elements, each on its own named layer. All dimensions are in meters (use the drawing-unit values directly).

1. BOUNDARY layer (color: White/7):
   - Draw a rectangle from (0, 0) to (12, 9).

2. BEDS layer (color: Green/3):
   - Central elliptical planting bed: center at (6, 4.5), major-axis radius 3.0 along X, minor-axis radius 1.8 along Y.
   - Four circular corner beds (radius 0.9 each) centered at: (2,2), (10,2), (2,7), (10,7).

3. WALKWAYS layer (color: Yellow/2):
   - Create two cross-axis walkways, each 1.2 m wide.
   - North-South walkway: Draw lines from (5.4, 0) to (5.4, 9) and from (6.6, 0) to (6.6, 9).
   - East-West walkway: Draw lines from (0, 3.9) to (12, 3.9) and from (0, 5.1) to (12, 5.1).

4. FOUNTAIN layer (color: Cyan/4):
   - Draw a circle at center (6, 4.5) with radius 0.45.

5. DIMENSIONS layer (color: Red/1):
   - Add at least 3 dimension annotations showing: the boundary width (12), boundary height (9), and the ellipse major axis (6 end-to-end or 3 radius).

Save the completed drawing to: ~/Documents/LibreCAD/garden_layout.dxf
